name: Ranger Musketeer Combat Style
body:
A ranger can select the musketeer combat style at second level instead of one of the other combat sytles.

Musketeer Combat Style

If a ranger selects musketeer, he is treated as having the Quick Load (musket) feat, even if he does not have the normal prerequisites for that feat. At sixth level he is treated as having the Far Shot feat, even if he does not have the normal prerequisites for that feat. At 11th level he is treated as having the Precise Shot feat, even if he does not have the normal prerequisites for that feat. As with the other combat styles, the benefits of the ranger’s musketeer style apply only when he wears light, medium, or no armor. He loses all benefits of his combat style feats when wearing heavy armor.
